# S2 eject parity: the semantics program prints identical output under
# logos build and under logos eject plus plain go build.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

logos run .
cp stdout $WORK/logos-stdout.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go

cd out
go run .
cp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/logos-stdout.txt
cd ..

cmp $WORK/logos-stdout.txt $WORK/eject-stdout.txt
cmp $WORK/logos-stdout.txt want-stdout.txt

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/defereject

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func failAt(n int) error {
	if n%2 == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("fail %d", n)
}

func loop(n int) (err error) {
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		defer failAt(i)?
	}
	return nil
}

type box struct{ v int }

func (b *box) close() error {
	b.v++
	return nil
}

func method(b *box) (err error) {
	defer b.close()?
	return nil
}

func join2() (err error) {
	defer failAt(1)?
	defer failAt(3)?
	return nil
}

var seen any = "unset"

func probe() error {
	seen = recover()
	return nil
}

func recoverInF() (err error) {
	defer probe()?
	panic("boom")
}

func recoverProbe() {
	defer func() {
		fmt.Println("recover in f:", seen, "outer:", recover())
	}()
	if err := recoverInF(); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("unexpected", err)
	}
}

func main() {
	if err := loop(3); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("loop err:", err)
	} else {
		fmt.Println("loop ok")
	}
	b := &box{}
	if err := method(b); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("method err:", err)
	} else {
		fmt.Println("method ok", b.v)
	}
	if err := join2(); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("join err:", err)
	} else {
		fmt.Println("join ok")
	}
	recoverProbe()
}

-- m/want-stdout.txt --
loop err: fail 1
method ok 1
join err: fail 3
fail 1
recover in f: <nil> outer: boom
